title: Research: prove the correlated P104 ideal entrance
body:
## Summary

PR3423 leaves final-cut cancellations separate from its 52-source prefix invariant. This proves the ideal correlated entrance and supplies one reachable literal separation for its actual first collector.

```text
Initial 58 banks in B9, ideal producer
    five disjoint Y-group sums in 4B9
    iff all six collector inputs are in B9

Literal initial Y27[0]=64, Y26[0]=-64, all other components zero
    exact full prefix, B9 failure at event 1090
    six literal zero collector inputs at cut 2025
```

The explicit integral bank-coordinate change gives 47 unrestricted B9 Y coordinates and five 4B9 coordinates. The written proof inherits the exact native covariance and B9 automorphism theorems. Gaussian multiples of the literal cancellation follow analytically from its integral trace. The universal ideal theorem and this literal family are separate claims.

Only `research/p104-correlated-entrance/` is added. Four predecessor proof/context notes are retained unchanged in ancestor `dd000b9884606deb954b6d90fb391be03684ddda`; final head is `ce2221dddab6efd3027c09269765dd7eb45f2877`. Exact origins, hashes and credit are in SOURCES.json.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3423 proves the stronger prefix invariant and a Y27-only counterexample, while leaving final-cut cancellations unclassified. **After:** source-derived rows prove the five ideal congruences; the explicit 52-by-52 coordinate maps pass both inverse identities. The literal paired input has 26 active native occurrences and 7,680 exact signed-floor versus ideal comparisons across all 2,025 prefix events and 883 native bindings. Deleting Y26 reproduces PR3423's exact failing D31 hash; amplitude 256 passes its stronger entrance.
- Registered normal/optimized complete receipts, five rejection groups with all 2,401 small Gaussian pairs, and scoped Ruff pass. The actual committed read-only Git-free export passes all three commands with all 15 files unchanged. Real optimized CLI corrupt-source, missing-source and Boolean-receipt mutants reject. Source-history and committed-byte checks pass. Human/formal proof-kernel review and hosted CI acceptance are unclaimed.

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-correlated-entrance
```

The direct standalone commands and complete evidence are in README.md, PROOF.md and RECEIPT.json. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2750#discussioncomment-19009365).

General correlated rounded-domain classification, actual preparation, downstream recipient histories, physical ownership/routing/restoration, a favorable complete bill and all-size transfer remain unproved. PR3423's unchanged-profile stop is retained. No supplier admission, improved kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Credit ywz65/PR2586, Arham Tahir/PR2665, Clear1nsight/PR3382 and PR3423, Tekalign/PR3025, Ross Richardson/PR3068, PR3406/PR3416 and the retained native, geometry, compiler and precision lineage. Apache-2.0.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** research.

An isolated proof and verifier package. The mathematical dependencies and the ideal/literal quantifier boundary require substantive review. Frozen inputs and the selected construction are unchanged.
